subject: Technical gates roadmap and stakeholder decision timeline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medutech.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Technical gates roadmap and stakeholder decision timeline

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the time on Friday. I promised to share a concise mutual action plan (MAP) template you can use to track the technical gates and stakeholder decisions for the pilot. I attached two stubs (MAP_Slides_v1.pptx) and also put a working Google Doc/Scheme in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBx-MAP-templates — feel free to comment directly.

High-level asks from our side so we can finalize the week of Sep 28:
- Confirm the technical checkpoints (API latency, privacy/network egress, sample dataset access) — owner + acceptance criteria per gate.
- Lock a 60-min technical review with your infra and ML leads (proposed: Thu Sep 24, 10:00–11:00 PT).
- Procurement: any baseline security artifacts you need up front (SOC2, DPA, penetration test report).

I’ve seeded the MAP doc with a suggested decision lane and a short acceptance checklist (see Slide 2). If you want a trimmed version for the executive sponsor, I can export a one-page acceptance canvas.

Next steps: if Sep 24 works I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read (1 pager). If not, propose two alternate slots next week.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this mapped out.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Stephanie — this is exactly what we needed to start. Quick answers and a couple of asks from our side: 

- Sep 24 10:00 PT works for our lead infra engineer (Marco) and our ML lead (Dr. Chen). Please send the invite with dial-in.
- Procurement requested our legal/compliance checklist before the technical review — they specifically want a current SOC2 report (redacted ok) and our proposed DPA language to route internally. I’ve CC'd procurement to this thread.
- For the MAP: can you include a short column for expected per-token cost estimate under both hosted and dedicated modes? That will help our finance folks align on the pilot budget.

On a related note, do you have an initial list of sandbox data access requirements so we can provision a scoped dataset for the demo?

Best —
Elena

Elena —

Great, thanks for confirming. Calendar invite sent for Thu Sep 24, 10:00–11:00 PT (includes dial-in + brief pre-read).

I uploaded the redacted SOC2 summary to our secure share and attached a stub in this thread (SOC2_report_redacted.pdf). Marissa (cc’d) will own delivery of any formal security artifacts and will loop in our security team for the DPA language.

I updated the MAP doc with the column you requested for estimated unit economics (hosted vs. dedicated). The doc includes a small worked example for a 500k token/day pilot and the assumptions used — please take a look in the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBx-MAP-templates

Sandbox data access: short list below to help you provision a scoped dataset for the demo: 
- Synthetically masked patient records (10k rows) — S3 read-only IAM role
- Example HL7 message bundle (sample.json) — s3 path and object key provided in Drive doc
- API key allowlist (one ephemeral key tied to demo CIDR range)

Acceptance criteria (summary from MAP slide deck):
1) End-to-end inference <350ms P95 for 1k concurrent requests
2) Model outputs match clinical intent threshold (F1 >= 0.82) on our seeded eval set
3) No outbound PII in logs (redaction QA)

We’ll present the acceptance canvas at the technical review and walk through the decision lane. If procurement needs a redline candidate for the DPA before the call, Marissa will push a draft tomorrow.

— Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_report_redacted.pdf (stub); MAP_Slides_v1.pptx (updated stub)
